name: Flux
review:
A colourful crystal-themed classic on 15 lines, built around rows of stacked wilds and three different bonus games, so the round you land changes how the feature plays.

It has a 2,562x cap and a 96.2% RTP. Thunderkick lists a number for volatility rather than a label, so we don't show a rating. An older game, but the variety of bonuses keeps it from feeling stale.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
